label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 60
title: Frontend: separate builds - operator app excluded from the customer package (not just hidden)
body: Build the operator surfaces (onboarding, customer mgmt, licensing admin, operator console) as a SEPARATE app/bundle that is NOT included in the customer package (separate entry/route tree; excluded from the customer build). The customer build ships only the tenant dashboard + tenant admin. Runtime INSTANCE_ROLE + platform_admin gating remains as defense-in-depth. Depends on backend BI-0070.
